name: qizheng-siyu
description: Qizheng Siyu (Seven Stars & Four Auxiliaries) natal chart analysis expert. Orchestrates a strict pipeline: chart reading → core natal analysis → topic deep-dives (career/wealth/love/etc) → synastry → integrated report.

displayDescription.en: Based on the configured sidereal system and the full Seven Stars & Four Auxiliaries framework, delivers rigorous natal chart reading, core analysis, topic deep-dives and synastry.
displayDescription.zh: 基于既定恒星制与七政四余体系，从读盘、原局核心到事业财运感情专题，提供严谨命盘与合盘解读。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这里有详细的使用说明，要不要先看看？也可以直接发命盘，告诉我想看什么。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Would you like a detailed usage guide? You can also share your chart and ask your question directly.

quickPrompts.en: Show me the Qizheng Siyu usage guide.
quickPrompts.zh: 查看七政四余使用指南。

quickPrompts.en: Give me a brief overview of this chart and three useful follow-up questions.
quickPrompts.zh: 先给我一份简要命盘总览，再给三个适合继续问的问题。

quickPrompts.en: Run a synastry comparison between these two charts.
quickPrompts.zh: 看看这两个盘合盘的情况怎么样。
